board: GY-BMI160 purple module (12 pins: VIN, 3V3, GND, SCL, SDA, CS, SAO / OCS, INT2, INT1, SCX, SDX)
reason: Part check PASS on ESP32 and Pico (spec, wiring, design checks, breadboard, simulator, circuit board, footprint). Registers, CMD sequence, little-endian 16-bit data, ±2 g/±2000 dps scaling and 23 + raw/512 temperature come from the Bosch datasheet; default address 0x69 because the module pulls SAO up.
